about_the_game:
📌 Game Overview

Ashen Dungeon is a turn-based strategy RPG where you lead an expedition team through dungeon exploration, resource farming & crafting, and tactical battles to defy fate. Featuring a dice-based combat system, every decision shapes your survival in an unpredictable world.

📜 Story & Lore

A world where hope has faded. Only those who defy fate will survive.
Once a prosperous kingdom, now lost in chaos. You must lead an expedition team and carve your own destiny. However, fate does not yield easily—every choice you make alters the course of your journey.

⚔️ Gameplay Features

  • 🛡️ Expedition Management – Recruit and train warriors to build the strongest team.

  • 🌀 Dungeon Exploration – Navigate ancient ruins, overcome perils, and uncover hidden treasures.

  • ⛏️ Resource Farming & Crafting – Gather materials from mining, logging, and craft essential survival tools.

  • ⚔️ Turn-Based Combat – Engage in tactical battles with a dice-based system, where strategy meets unpredictability.

content_descriptors.notes: Skeleton objects are placed in the scene, and damage occurs due to combat between characters and monsters. Although blood is not shown, petrified mortals can still meet their death.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2.5 GHz / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GTX 1050 / AMD RX550
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 2.8 GHz / AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GTX 1080 / AMD RX 5600
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
